background: The business began in 1972 as Hindusthan Seals, making metal closures and packaging in Kolkata; it was incorporated in 1984 and renamed Manaksia Ltd in 2003-04 as it moved into galvanised and coated steel, aluminium and other products. It went abroad early, starting operations in Nigeria in 1996, and today runs plants in Nigeria and Ghana through subsidiaries. A court-approved scheme effective 2013-14 split the undertakings into Manaksia Steels, Manaksia Aluminium, Manaksia Coated Metals and Manaksia Industries, each now held by a separate family line. Manaksia Ltd stays with Suresh Kumar and Basudeo Agrawal, the coated-metals company with Sushil Kumar Agrawal and sons, and aluminium with Sunil Kumar Agrawal and son.

background: The listed company traces to Adhunik Rollers Pvt Ltd, incorporated in West Bengal in November 1968; it took the MSP Steel & Power name and became a public company in 2003. background: Mahabir Prasad Agarwal laid the foundation over five decades in steel and ferro alloys; the first operating company, Shyam SEL and Power, was incorporated in September 1991, and the listed company followed in December 2002 as Shyam DRI Power. background: Subhas Chandra Agarwalla incorporated Maithan Alloys in Kolkata in September 1985 and became its MD in 1992; the Agarwalla family is based in Asansol. The first ferro-alloy furnace (10 MVA) at Kalyaneshwari near Asansol was built from 1995 and began production in April 1997, and capacity was scaled to 49 MVA within a decade. Plants followed at Byrnihat in Meghalaya and Visakhapatnam, and the group bought Impex Metal & Ferro Alloys (Bobbili, Andhra Pradesh) under insolvency and merged it. It is a single-stage manganese-alloy maker with a large treasury book, and in 2025-26 set up new subsidiaries in food, capital and electronics.

background: The Kolkata-based Shakambhari Group, led by Deepak Agarwal (over three decades in the trade), grew almost entirely by buying and reviving shut or insolvent steel plants. It took over the closed Maa Chhinnamastika Steel & Power plant in Purulia in December 2010, Bravo Sponge Iron from the Bhalotia group in 2015, Eloquent Steel in fiscal 2018 and SPS Steels Rolling Mills (Elegant brand) through insolvency for about Rs 270 crore. In February 2023 it acquired Ess Dee Aluminium from the insolvency tribunal (later renamed Shakambhari Ispat and Power), adding aluminium foil, and it has since taken on Gontermann Peipers. Today it runs a pellet-to-rolled-products chain with ferro alloys and captive power; the next generation is not identified in sources read.

background: Usha Martin was founded in 1960 with a single wire-rope plant in Ranchi by the brothers Brij Kishore and Basant Kumar Jhawar. It grew into an integrated maker of steel, wire and wire ropes, with overseas rope plants in Thailand, the UK and the UAE. After the brothers' sons fell out (Prashant, Basant's son, was removed as chairman in 2017 and Basant was voted off the board in 2019), the steel business at Jamshedpur was sold to Tata Steel in 2019 to cut debt. Today it is a focused global wire-rope company run by Brij Kishore's son Rajeev Jhawar, while the Basant/Prashant side has been selling down its stake.
